# laravelforge_monitor (Resource)

Manages a server monitor on a Laravel Forge server. Forge monitors cannot be edited in place, so every configurable attribute forces replacement. Requires the Business plan.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notify` (String) Email address notified when the monitor is in an alert state. Cannot be changed in place.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator against the threshold (`gte` or `lte`). Cannot be changed in place.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the monitor belongs to.
- `threshold` (Number) Percentage threshold to alert on once breached. Cannot be changed in place.
- `type` (String) Metric type (`cpu_load`, `disk`, `free_memory`, or `used_memory`). Cannot be changed in place.

### Optional

- `minutes` (Number) Frequency in minutes to evaluate the monitor. Cannot be changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the monitor.
- `state` (String) Current state of the monitor (`OK`, `ALERT`, or `UNKNOWN`).
- `state_changed_at` (String) Timestamp the monitor state last changed.
- `status` (String) Installation status of the monitor (e.g. `installed`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
